story.fullStory:
Gerry Rafferty's "Baker Street" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Baker Street" is a single by the Scottish singer-songwriter Gerry Rafferty, released in February 1978.

It won the 1979 Ivor Novello Award for Best Song Musically and Lyrically and reached the top three in the UK, US and elsewhere.

The song is known for its saxophone riff, written by Rafferty and performed by Raphael Ravenscroft.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.
